blocks.text: The last time Angie Beard played for the Philippines in New Zealand, she was part of one of her country’s greatest ever football moments. So the Melbourne Victory defender can’t wait to head back across the ditch to ramp up preparations for her second Women’s World Cup in Brazil next year. READ: From Asian Games to World Cup, Filipinas in for tough buildup Back in 2023, the Philippines, then under former Matildas coach Alen Stajcic, claimed their first World Cup victory with a 1-0 defeat of co-hosts New Zealand.
